title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?
description:
Fall into a small black hole and you could be torn apart before you reach it. Fall into a giant one, and NASA says you get 12.8 seconds past the edge.
In 2024, NASA simulated a fall into a black hole like the one at the center of our galaxy. Here's the whole trip: what you'd see, what a friend watching from far away would see, why the small black hole is the dangerous one, the star astronomers actually watched get "spaghettified", and the astronaut who comes home 36 minutes younger.

The 3D scenes are illustrations based on NASA's simulation and the sources below. Real images are credited on screen.
